name: Nayan Modi
subtitle: AI/ML Engineer & Systems Enthusiat
bio: Hi, I'm a 19 year old software engineer, cybersecurity researcher, CTF player, and curious mind deeply interested in open-source, cybersecurity, and digital investigations. I build things for fun (and sometimes they are actually useful).

Outside of studying, I'm usually writing code, exploring security challenges, watching anime, reading, listening to music, or taking photos. I've worked at startups and non-profits, and most of my projects are available on GitHub. Currently balancing academics, programming, and whatever else catches my interest. My security research has been featured in national & international media outlets like BBC, Bloomberg, India Today & multiple others.
I'm open to new roles, collaborations, and opportunities. You can see my resume or reach out at hello@ni5arga.com.
If you're here, chances are I'd enjoy talking to you - I get nerd-sniped easily, and an email about something that recently fascinated you would honestly make my day.
